# Mimica Launches Partner Program to Help Accelerate Client AI Transformation

# Mimica Launches Partner Program to Help Accelerate Client AI Transformation

Author

Mimica

Share

[LinkedIn icon](https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-launches-partner-program-to-help-accelerate-client-ai-transformation#) [Facebook icon](https://www.mimica.ai/articles/mimica-launches-partner-program-to-help-accelerate-client-ai-transformation#)

Every AI transformation starts with the same question: where do we begin? Enterprises often bring that question to the consulting firms and partners they already trust. The new [Mimica Partner Program](https://www.mimica.ai/partnerships) gives those advisors a way to answer it with data on how work actually gets done. Partners get a faster, more defensible way to advance AI initiatives across the accounts they serve, from process discovery through automation delivery.

Nearly 9 in 10 organizations now use AI regularly, yet only 44% say it's scaling across their enterprise, according to the [McKinsey 2026 State of AI survey](https://www.mckinsey.com/~/media/mckinsey/business%20functions/quantumblack/our%20insights/the%20state%20of%20ai/the-state-of-ai-in-2026-on-the-road-to-roi-aug-2026.pdf). The Mimica Partner Program equips those advisors with real-world process data, so every recommendation they make starts from how work actually gets done rather than how process documents say it should.

"Mimica's clients are looking to trusted advisors to guide them through their AI transformation journeys. That's why partnerships are central to our strategy," said Tuhin Chakraborty, CEO of Mimica. "When we pair Mimica's AI-powered task mining and process mapping with the expertise of partners our clients already rely on, enterprises can move from AI ambition to measurable results faster."

### What partners can do with Mimica

Partners use Mimica to support their clients at every stage of a transformation program:

- **Pinpointing where value lives.** Partners replace manual discovery and stakeholder interviews with objective, data-backed evidence of where transformation can have the greatest impact.
- **Moving from insight to design in weeks.** Partners generate standard operating procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and integration designs in weeks, giving their teams a strong foundation for AI transformation.
- **Turning recommendations into results.** Partners move beyond strategy to support the deployment of future-state AI and automation that drives measurable outcomes for clients.

### Early partners see results

Mimica partners already use the [platform](https://www.mimica.ai/product) to turn opinions about how work gets done into evidence.

[Accordion](https://www.accordion.com/), the value creation partner for private equity, used Mimica to get to the root of a collections process that drew frequent complaints:

> "Mimica provides detailed, unbiased insight into how processes are actually being performed. Using Miner and the Analyst tool, we translated anecdotal and qualitative complaints about a collections process into quantifiable data, helping us pinpoint the highest impact improvement opportunities." - Nathaniel Franks, Director at Accordion.

[Jolera](https://www.jolera.com/), a global systems integrator for managed IT, cloud, and cybersecurity, uses Mimica to ground its client AI and automation work in real behavioral data:

> "Partnering with Mimica has transformed how we deliver value to our clients. The depth of behavioral insight their platform provides, capturing what employees actually do and not just what processes say they should, gives us a foundation for AI and automation programs that deliver real, measurable results from day one." - Terence Persaud, CTO of Jolera.

### Become a Mimica partner

Consulting firms, managed service providers (MSPs), business process outsourcing (BPO) providers, and other partners interested in joining the Mimica Partner Program can apply at [https://www.mimica.ai/partnerships](https://www.mimica.ai/partnerships).
